newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NetComm in unit merger talks with Banksia.
newsitem.headline: NetComm in unit merger talks with Banksia.

text.p: NetComm Ltd said on Monday that it had sought a trading halt against its shares ahead of the possible merger of its analogue modem business with rival Banksia Technology Pty Ltd.
"While no final agreement has currently been reached, NetComm expects to sign a formal merger agreement by Friday, 18 July," the company said.
NetComm shares were three cents higher at 60 cents before the trading halt was applied on Monday morning by the stock exchange at the company's request.
The Sydney-based modem maker said in late February that it would restructure its operations, including the sale or merger of some divisions, following continued losses and falling sales.
